contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROM]ANOR[VM]. Reverse shows an Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding labarum. Mint is Arles, AD 364-378. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right.
